hypothesis: Reusing the already allocated session FFN intermediate for recorded Q4_K decode removes fused_ffn_output pool acquisitions and reduces complete-request latency. No binding cache or output reuse.
candidate: Forward session-owned intermediate only on recorded, single-token, scalar F32 Q4_K fused gate/up without norm-stats, adapters, training or diagnostics. Last consumer is down projection; queue order precedes the next write.
control: Frozen allocator runtime; same configuration, grouping, weights, shader arithmetic and workload.

primary.acceptance: All tokens/text exact and lifecycle pass; paired opening-level warm median complete-latency gain >=2%, two-sided 95% paired bootstrap lower bound >0, median first output/decode and measured peak memory no regression >3%. Fixed sample count, no optional stopping.

attribution: Separate instrumented pass times BufferPool.acquire and GPUDevice.createBuffer and counts labels; not used for speed claims. Primary pass only reads counters outside timed generation.
lifecycle: unload while unrelated session remains usable
limitations: Fresh browser/HTTP opening is not OS-cache-cold loading
Peak pool and browser RSS are not total physical GPU memory
Physical Vulkan successor qualification independent of Metal performance
